summary.title: Summary
summary.content: Senior iOS Developer & Apple Platforms Architect with 10+ years of experience building scalable, high-performance applications using Swift, Objective-C, UIKit, and modern Swift 6 concurrency. Proven track record of delivering enterprise-grade products (Civica - Collect) and production platforms (Ezy Sign In) from architecture to App Store deployment. Experienced full-stack contributor with C#/.NET, Python, and JavaScript. Open-source author of 11 Swift packages, AI developer tools, and cloud engineering guides covering Passkeys, SwiftData, CoreData, PDFKit AcroForms, CoreLocation, and CI/CD pipelines. Adept at mentoring junior developers, conducting code reviews, and collaborating in cross-functional Agile teams.

highlights: Architected and delivered business-critical features across regular release trains for Civica - Collect, an enterprise debt recovery platform serving local government authorities and commercial enforcement agencies.
Conducted technical impact analysis and designed modular software components adhering to established design patterns (Repository, Factory, CQRS, Singleton, and MVVM).
Provided Tier-3 application support against agreed client Service Level Agreements (SLAs), resolving complex production defects, performance bottlenecks, and sync edge cases.
Delivered end-to-end full-stack capabilities across native iOS (Swift/Objective-C), modern web frontend (JavaScript, Cappuccino/Objective-J), and backend services (C#/.NET Core, MySQL).

Enforced strict ISO 9001 Quality Management standards through comprehensive multi-tier unit testing (XCTest for iOS, OJTest for Cappuccino web, and C# backend tests), peer PR code reviews, and Git version control hygiene.

Collaborated closely with Product Owners, Technical Architects, and Project Managers in an Agile scrum environment while automating CI/CD workflows with Azure DevOps, Azure Pipelines, and GitHub Actions.
Built and shipped multiple iOS applications in Swift and Objective-C across MVC, MVVM, and MVP architectures for clients in sports, training, and lifestyle domains.
Designed complex UI components using Auto Layout, Size Classes, and custom animations for iPhone and iPad.
Integrated REST APIs, in-app purchases, JSON/XML parsing, and Firebase push notifications.
Improved code quality by implementing Git-based workflows, code reviews, and reusable components.
Delivered apps live on the App Store with high ratings, collaborating with cross-functional teams.

items.name: Civica - Collect
items.description: Enterprise debt recovery and enforcement platform serving local government authorities. Architected business-critical features, performed technical impact analysis, and led client ticket investigations against Tier-3 SLAs. Automated multi-stage CI/CD via Azure DevOps, Azure Pipelines, and GitHub Actions while driving comprehensive unit testing across iOS (XCTest), web (OJTest), and C# backend tests.

items.name: Ezy Sign In
items.description: Built the new Ezy Sign In app from scratch using Swift 6, UIKit, and MVVM-R (Router/Coordinator) architecture; also maintained legacy Objective-C version — both live on the App Store. Features touchless QR check-in, camera photo capture (AVFoundation), NDA signing (WebKit), and auto badge printing via Brother thermal printers (WiFi/Bluetooth).

items.name: Skate to Ski
items.description: Implemented key UI flows, interactive video training modules, and onboarding experience; contributed to App Store release and resolved multi-device performance bottlenecks.

items.name: My Board & Coaches
items.description: Developed coach discovery modules, real-time messaging, and robust offline caching using Core Data. Optimized cold-start time by 30% through cached image pipelines.

items.name: PasskeyManager
items.description: Swift 6 zero-dependency wrapper for Apple Passkeys (WebAuthn/FIDO2) — async/await, task cancellation safety, cross-platform (iOS/macOS).

items.name: CoreDataManager
items.description: Thread-safe Core Data singleton — batch updates/deletes, persistent history tracking, Combine publisher, multi-context architecture.

items.name: SwiftDataManager
items.description: Modern SwiftData persistence layer — @ModelActor for thread safety, generic repository pattern, in-memory testing support.

items.name: LocationManager
items.description: Production-ready CoreLocation wrapper — geofencing, geocoding, compass, visit monitoring; Combine + async/await + delegate APIs.

items.name: PhotoCaptureManager
items.description: Camera & photo library manager — privacy-preserving PHPickerViewController, interactive dismissal safety, iPad popover support.

items.name: FontManager
items.description: Design system typography engine — 21 semantic tokens, Dynamic Type (UIFontMetrics), CoreText custom font registration, UIKit + SwiftUI.

items.name: PDFFormHelper
items.description: Production-ready PDFKit utility — AcroField form management, interactive checkbox/radio controls, signature stamping, draft persistence, rotation-aware flattening.

items.name: azure-pipelines-guide
items.description: Comprehensive reference guide & Docsify documentation site for Azure DevOps Pipelines, Fastlane match, multi-stage YAML pipelines, and code signing.

items.name: aws-beginner-guide
items.description: Comprehensive 16-module AWS cloud guide & Material for MkDocs documentation site covering EC2, Lambda, S3, VPC, RDS/DynamoDB, IAM, and cost control.

items.name: macos-dir-tools
items.description: Zero-dependency CLI suite for macOS & Linux — 3-phase duplicate file hashing, O(1) AWK disk usage stats, recursive inventory scanning, and .DS_Store handling.

items.name: photo-curator
items.description: AI photo curation engine — OpenAI CLIP ViT-B/32 neural aesthetics, OpenCV sharpness, burst deduplication, Apple Silicon MPS, and two-phase transactional staging.
